content.short: bloXroute Labs provides MEV discovery and execution service supporting bundles, private TXs, mempool, and block-building streams.
content.description: bloXroute Labs is a Chicago-based blockchain software company founded in 2018. Its Blockchain Distribution Network (BDN) delivers hyper-connectivity across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, and Solana, enabling ultra-low-latency DeFi trading with unmatched speed and performance in DeFi and MEV ecosystems. Built to elevate on-chain transactions and data transmission, the BDN supports rapid market activity and efficient access to critical blockchain data for developers, traders, and infrastructure teams.
